newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Hudson Conway to raise A$105.4 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Hudson Conway to raise A$105.4 mln.

text.p: Hudson Conway Ltd said on Friday it would offer A$105.4 million of seven year unsecured exchangeable notes, with the offer underwritten by Prudential Bache Securities Australia Ltd.

The company, which is the controlling shareholder in Melbourne casino operator Crown Ltd with a 31 percent stake, said the offer would consist of 34 million notes issued at A$3.10 each and paying 7.25 percent per annum.
It said the offer also allowed for the raising of a further A$24.8 million via an over-subscription of eight million notes.
Hudson said each note can be redeemed at face value and used as consideration for one ordinary Crown Ltd share between January 11 1999 and February 11, 2002.
The funds raised could be used to pursue major projects in Australia, for working capital, and to retire debt, it said.
